thread:
maria-support: FYI incoming onboarding issue from NimbleTech. They can see the API key in the org console but calls return 403 when they set the project header. Asking for urgent triage.
kevin-ops: Please paste project id + example of failing request and I'll check the binding table.
maria-support: Project id: proj-nimble-42
maria-support: Customer repro (redacted key):
```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer rk_live_zzZ123REDACTED\" --header \"X-Redwood-Project: proj-nimble-42\" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  \"error\": \"api_key_not_authorized_for_project\",
  \"detail\": \"key not bound to requested project\"
}
```
anika-identity: Sounds like a claim attach race. UI may have returned success before the background attach completed. Check key claim_state and bound_project.
sam-engineer: Running quick DB query to find key record:
```
SELECT id, key_value_hash, scope, bound_project, claim_state, created_at
FROM api_keys
WHERE key_value_hash LIKE '%zzZ123%';
```
Result: id=2109, scope="org", bound_project=NULL, claim_state="claim_pending", created_at="2026-02-11T09:12:23Z"
kevin-ops: Ok match. deploy-bot, any errors in provisioner logs around that time?
deploy-bot: [provisioner] 2026-02-11T09:12:24Z - job claim-attach-2109 - ERROR - attach timeout: downstream project metadata service slow
maria-support: Customer says they clicked "Assign to project" and saw the key move in the UI, but afterwards it still shows under org keys and requests fail.
anika-identity: That indicates the UI toggled client-side state. We need to force a reconcile and ensure audit log entry exists.
sam-engineer: Triggering adhoc reconcile: `provisioner reconcile --key-id=2109 --force --log-level=info`
Reconcile log:
```
INFO fetching key id=2109
INFO evaluating claims for proj-nimble-42
INFO attaching key to project proj-nimble-42
WARN downstream service latency high but continuing
INFO updated api_keys.bound_project=proj-nimble-42
INFO audit: action=key.bind key_id=2109 project=proj-nimble-42 user=console-ui
SUCCESS: key 2109 bound to proj-nimble-42
```
kevin-ops: After reconcile, introspection should show bound_project. sam, can you run the introspect endpoint?
sam-engineer: Introspect output:
```
GET /v1/keys/2109/introspect
{
  \"key_id\": \"2109\",
  \"status\": \"active\",
  \"scopes\": [\"inference\"],
  \"bound_project\": \"proj-nimble-42\"
}
```
maria-support: Relayed this to customer and asked them to retry. They replied: "Works now, thanks! :tada: we got a 200 and responses."
anika-identity: Root cause: transient timeout in claim attach worker when project metadata API responded slowly. Action: add exponential retries with jitter for attach, surface pending state in console UI so it doesn't show success prematurely.
kevin-ops: I'll add an alert for provisioner attach error rate > 0.5% over 15m and a dashboard panel for claim queue length.
sam-engineer: I'll add a reconcile-on-failure job that retries failed attaches for 24h and a lightweight migration to surface claim_state in console list.
maria-support: Closing customer ticket. Filing follow-up doc in #docs-onboarding and tagging infra + idp. Support ticket INC-2026-487 marked resolved.
support-bot: Ticket INC-2026-487 closed by maria-support — customer confirmed fix."
